title: Eleven Minutes of Waiting
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术）　|　核心词汇：computer　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 computer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 my father ① switched on a computer that filled a room and did one thing, and he said the switching on was the whole of the work. The ② computer, meaning the machine and not the answer, took eleven minutes to warm and stayed warm; computer, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is given.

Every ③ computer in that building had the same fan, and the ④ computer at the end, meaning the one he kept for the payroll and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever trusted twice. Computer, my mother said, is nine parts waiting and one part somebody willing to feed it; my father said the feeding is the part that fills the cards.

My grandmother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the computer was the whole of the argument, meaning the number it produced and not the machine. The ⑥ computer, meaning the number and not any of that, is the only thing in an argument that everybody quotes and nobody checks; computer, she said, is either something you switch on or the only word that means both a machine and a number. He said the number is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ computer had become a line in a budget, and the budget had become an argument about the fan. The ⑧ computer of the whole thing, my father wrote in April, was one room and thirty years of feeding; computer, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to wait. She said the waiting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ computer I remember is the one at the end, which was installed in 1992 and is still described as the loudest in the county. A ⑩ computer, my mother said in 1994, is the only thing that improves by being trusted; every computer, she said, is a number that has agreed to look like a machine. She said the number was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 计算机（指那台机器本身，与那个答案相对）
C. 固定搭配：switch on a computer 打开计算机
D. n. 计算机（指那栋楼里每一台）
E. n. 计算机（指末尾那一台）
F. n. 计算机（指它算出来的那个数字）
G. n. 计算机（指预算里提到的那一台）
H. n. 算力；计算（抽象总称）

items.q: switched on a computer that filled a room
The computer, meaning the machine and not the answer
the computer was the whole of the argument
the computer had become a line in a budget
The computer of the whole thing
A computer, my mother said in 1994

answers.why: switch on a computer 意为“打开计算机”，1978 年父亲打开了一台占满一间屋子、只做一件事的计算机。
computer 意为“计算机”，指那台机器本身而不是那个答案，它预热要十一分钟。
computer 指那栋楼里每一台计算机，每一台都有同样的风扇。
computer 指末尾那一台（他留给工资单的那一台），是唯一有人信任过两次的。
computer 意为“计算机算出来的那个数字”，祖母说那个数字就是那场争论的全部，而不是那台机器。
computer 为转喻用法，指机器给出的那个数字而不是机器本身，是争论里人人都引用、却无人核对的东西。
computer 意为“计算机”，指预算里提到的那一台，到 1986 年这台计算机成了预算里的一行。
computer 意为“算力、计算”，父亲四月写道，整件事的计算是一间屋子三十年的输入。
computer 意为“计算机”，我记得的是末尾那一台，1992 年安装，至今仍被说成全县声音最大的。
computer 为抽象总称，母亲说一台计算机是唯一会因为被信任而变好的东西。
